name: Uneased To Meet You!
author: Drion22
description: We'd love your feedback on the game! Just click on the link: https://forms.gle/N3DBXD2sHu8FNrUv9 Remember to unmute and full-screen recommended for proper scaling! Story-based Platformer where you play as a person who lives with social anxiety. You move with WASD or the Arrow keys, and Spacebar to move and jump. You also use the Spacebar to move on from the initial phone screen. While talking with people, you can pick an answer and then drag and drop the correct words to build it. If you say something wrong, take too long, or fall down, your anxiety will increase and conversations will get harder. If you get engaged in the conversation and pick longer sentences, your anxiety will decrease as you get into the habit of interacting with people. Some things get harder as you get more anxious! Graffiti Generator (Used for Grafitti fonts): https://fontmeme.com/graffiti-creator/ Art inspired by https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCX4mqbvv5lGqLpI4FYlJt4w
